capabilities: Chat with notes by attaching the current note, a selection, or files as context
Inspect sources, citations, and outgoing context before sending messages
Fork conversations into independent chats linked back to their parent
Manage vault memory with local editing and AI extraction or proposals
Generate local article catalogs as an Obsidian Base and Markdown navigation page
disambiguation: An independent community project, not an official DeepSeek or Obsidian product, despite the DeepSeek branding and icon.
extras: Interface is currently primarily Chinese with no English UI yet; Obsidian labels the listing as not manually reviewed; desktop only (Obsidian 1.13.7+, no mobile); inline completion has rate limits of 10 calls/minute and 200/UTC day per vault.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to chat with an AI model grounded in your notes, inspect what context was sent, or keep chat and memory stored locally in the vault.

relations.evidence: powered by a locally installed DeepSeek Harness (DSH) runtime
sidebar interaction design draws inspiration from Claudian
The README organization takes inspiration from dsh-TUI

requires.name: Model provider credentials configured in DSH
Cloud AI or search provider accounts
Paid DeepSeek providers used by inline completion

summary: Desktop AI chat assistant that runs a local DeepSeek Harness runtime to answer questions with note context, citations, conversation forks, vault memory, and catalogs.
